Step 9/9-later Paige Cognetti   Cognetti, Oregon native, pads her resume, caters 
to liberal agenda to climb the ladder, absentee 
mayor, raised property taxes. Her political 
ambition paid for by taxpayers. What brought 
Paige to Scranton? “Politics”, in her own words.  
Love 9/16-later Paige Cognetti   Paige Cognetti knows that Scranton’s taxes are 
high, yet she won’t lower them.  Now she wants 
you to pay higher taxes AND she wants a higher 
office.  Cognetti loves getting ahead and moving 
up, no matter the cost. 
Don’t Get 9/26-later Paige Cognetti   Jeff, an owner of a mom & pop repair shop says 
Paige raises city taxes every year. She don’t care. 
Then she wants to go put all of the money into 
illegals. “I don’t get no free money.” All she is 
worried about is climbing and climbing the 
ladder.  Chryon:  “Helping Herself. Hurting Us.” 
Take 10/5-later Paige Cognetti   Working man says Paige don’t care, she’s not 
here for us.  All she does is tax, tax, tax and take, 
take, take while the illegals are getting free, free, 
free.  She just wants to climb the ladder. She 
don’t care what it costs. Send her back to Oregon. 
Screw 10/15-later Paige Cognetti   Random men speaking on camera: “Paige 
Cognetti if out for herself…. I think she’d screw 
over her own family….Our tax dollars doubled and 
tripled…. She has taxed people to death….Money 
we paid for Medicare she gives to illegals for 
free…. It’s Paige first, illegals second and we come 
in dead last.”
